mechanism: Etanercept (TNF-alpha inhibitor) increases infection risk and may potentiate fluphenazine's immunosuppressive effects, while fluphenazine's anticholinergic and CNS depressant properties may complicate clinical monitoring.
action: Monitor closely for signs of infection and ensure appropriate infection prophylaxis; assess for increased CNS/anticholinergic effects; use lowest effective fluphenazine dose.
